lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\CIDgravity\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
vendor/ ships 7 packages that the server ships itself in a major of Nextcloud 29 to 32. Both copies define the same classes, and the autoloader that is asked first decides which version runs.
psr/log 1.1.4, in 3rdparty/ of Nextcloud 29 to 32
sabre/dav 4.7.0, in 3rdparty/ of Nextcloud 29 to 32
sabre/event 5.1.7, in 3rdparty/ of Nextcloud 29 to 32
sabre/http 5.1.12, in 3rdparty/ of Nextcloud 29 to 32

phpunit/phpunit is in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.
The app has 2 OCS routes and no openapi.json. Clients of OCS are generated from such a specification, and nothing else tells them what these routes take and return.
